 Build clear, opinionated messaging that helps everyone at Airspeed talk about our platform consistently — and continuously evolve it as we expand into a multi-product, agent-driven platform.

 Partner with Product to identify high-impact use cases, prioritize what we bring to market, and ensure features are packaged and positioned in ways that resonate with buyers.

 Turn product releases into compelling market moments — package features into outcomes and use cases people actually care about, and build repeatable launch frameworks as we scale.

 Develop detailed buyer personas across CRO, VP Sales, RevOps, and Enablement audiences; build messaging that aligns with how these buyers think, evaluate, and buy.

 Create sales narratives, talk tracks, and enablement assets that help reps communicate value clearly and confidently sell an AI-native, agent-driven platform.

 Develop compelling case studies, success stories, and proof points that turn real customer workflows into scalable content and sales assets.

 Own product storytelling across LinkedIn, website, campaigns, and sales channels — with as much focus on distribution as creation.

 Leverage AI tools (including Airspeed) to scale content, workflows, and experimentation; continuously test new ways to increase output and effectiveness.

 Act as the connective layer between Product and GTM — aligning Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success around a shared narrative and ensuring clarity on what we're launching and why it matters.

 Qualifications

 Strong background partnering with Product, Marketing, and Sales on GTM execution.

 Revenue-focused mindset with a solid understanding of buying journeys, sales processes, and expansion motions.

 Proven ability to create compelling content and narratives that drive engagement and demand.

 Experience with content distribution, campaigns, and experimentation across channels.

 Exceptional communication skills across written, verbal, and visual formats.

 A bias for action: creative, first-principles thinker who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

 Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and working closely across Sales, Product, and Engineering.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience at an early-stage startup or in a GTM ecosystem or Product Management role.

 A passion for AI-native products and agent-driven workflows.

 What We Value 
 Customer obsession and a relentless focus on measurable impact.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.
 
 The Role: 
 The Senior Technical Project Manager at CoMind will lead the delivery of a complex, multi-disciplinary sub-system spanning optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, FPGAs, and software. The role owns end-to-end planning and execution, coordinating internal engineering teams and external development partners to take the sub-system through the full product development lifecycle, from design maturation through to verification and transfer.
 This is a senior, hands-on role focused on disciplined technical project delivery in a fast-moving medtech start-up.
 The successful candidate will translate technical and programme objectives into a clear, well-structured plan, managing scope, schedule, resources, risk, and cross-discipline dependencies, while maintaining the pace and pragmatism a start-up demands.
 CoMind is entering a critical phase of design maturation, verification, and scale-up. This role is central to ensuring the sub-system is delivered on time, to specification, and to the quality and regulatory standards expected of a medical device, without sacrificing momentum or engineering rigour.
  
 At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week in the office, plus a flexible work-from-home day. This role is based in our London (Kings Cross) office. 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Owning end-to-end planning and delivery of the sub-system project across optics, electronics, mechanical, FPGA, and software workstreams, from concept through to design verification and transfer

 Building and maintaining the integrated project plan, including scope, schedule, milestones, critical path, and cross-discipline dependencies

 Leading a multi-disciplinary team of engineers and external development partners, coordinating activities and resolving technical and resourcing conflicts to keep delivery on track

 Establishing and running effective project governance, including regular reporting, steering reviews, and clear, accurate status communication to senior stakeholders

 Owning the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies), proactively identifying and mitigating risks before they affect schedule, cost, or quality

 Managing resourcing and capacity across disciplines, forecasting demand and working with functional leads to ensure the right skills are available at the right time

 Driving the project through the formal product development lifecycle, ensuring design control, verification and validation, and stage-gate requirements are met

 Managing external partners and suppliers, including statements of work, deliverables, and the technical and commercial commitments that underpin the project

 Tracking budget, effort, and cost against plan, and providing accurate forecasts to support decision-making

 Ensuring project documentation and deliverables meet the quality and traceability standards required for a regulated medical device (e.g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971)

 AI is fundamental to our culture — it's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.
 

 Skills & Experience: 
 Proven track record managing complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects through the full product development lifecycle

 Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating multi-disciplinary teams spanning optics, electronics, mechanical, FPGA, and software, alongside external development partners

 Strong command of formal project management processes, including planning, scheduling, critical-path management, reporting, RAID, resourcing, and budget control

 Experience delivering products that integrate hardware, embedded/FPGA, and software, with a sound understanding of the interfaces and integration challenges involved

 Comfortable operating in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up environment, balancing process rigour with pragmatism and pace

 Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers across disciplines and challenge constructively when required

 Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a track record of clear, accurate reporting to senior leadership

 Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with a track record of driving delivery without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

 Experience working within or alongside regulated environments (e.g. medical devices, ISO 13485, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, design controls) is highly desirable, as is a recognised project management qualification (e.g. APM, PMP, PRINCE2)
 

 Benefits: 
 Company equity plan so all employees

jobs.description:
At ARISE, responsibility is at the heart of everything we do. Every day, we dedicate ourselves to realizing our clients’ visions and driving their digital projects to success. As a community of experts, we support each other and grow together to achieve exceptional results. Our sense of responsibility – toward our clients and our colleagues – defines our success. 
 
 ARISE with us and apply today as a Technical Product Manager (m/f/d) with a Focus on Platforms, in a permanent position . This role can be performed remotely anywhere in Germany with regular on-site client engagements, approximately two days per week. 
 
 As part of this role, you will identify new business opportunities and win clients for ARISE. You are passionate about developing customer relationships, thrive on opening new doors, and have the tenacity and resilience to turn prospects into long-term clients. 
 
 Role Trajectory: 
 This role is designed to be actively shaped and driven by the person in it. While the near-term focus is strongly centered on delivery, execution, and stabilising platform-level coherence under ongoing pressure, you are expected to deliberately push the role and the platform toward a more outcome-driven footing. This includes elevating operator experience, operability, and cost efficiency to first-class product concerns. 
 
 Your Responsibilities: 
 
 You will take end-to-end ownership for platform-level coherence across multiple product lines , balancing short-term delivery demands with the long-term evolution of the platform toward usability, operability, and cost efficiency. 

 You will represent Platform Operations as a primary customer persona and act as their main interface into product management , shaping the end-to-end operational journey of the platform and translating operational, reliability, and cost-related needs into clear and actionable product priorities. 

 You will own platform level dependency management by identifying, maintaining, and communicating functional dependencies across the product portfolio to enable reliable release planning, operational troubleshooting, and informed decision making. 

 You will ensure a coherent platform experience across product lines by critically reviewing roadmap scope, sequencing, and cross-product touch points for tenant-facing offerings and by actively preventing fragmentation and UX drift at platform level. 

 You will provide strategic oversight and governance for customer-facing releases by reviewing and signing off on product strategy, functional scope, and platform alignment across all releases within your area of responsibility. 

 You will actively surface, resolve, and de-risk cross-product dependencies by identifying unknowns early, unblocking teams, and ensuring consistent platform behavior and correct sequencing across planning and delivery. You will do this while progressively shifting the role from execution-driven coordination toward strategic platform stewardship . 

 You will drive new business by identifying, engaging, and winning new clients while building long-term customer relationships that support ARISE's continued growth. 

 
 Your Benefits: 
 
 Attractive compensation: We offer a competitive overall package consisting of an annual salary aligned with current market standards, plus an additional bonus package with further individual benefits. 

 Extensive development opportunities: You’ll receive comprehensive onboarding and have access to exciting, hands-on learning modules through our ARISE College , where you can continuously expand your skills. 

 Modern company culture: We embrace flat hierarchies and a value-driven culture where people come first. Your opinion and your contribution truly matter to us. 

 Opportunities to shape and grow: Be part of our growth story and actively help shape the future of ARISE . Your ideas and commitment are welcome and appreciated. 

 Community and team spirit: You’ll work with a team that is more than just colleagues – we are a community that supports, challenges, and inspires each other. 

 Flexibility: With a high degree of remote work, you can work from anywhere in Germany and organize your workday flexibly. 

 Investment in your future: ARISE actively invests in your professional growth through trainings, workshops, and personal coaching. You can also look forward to annual workations in inspiring European destinations, regular offsites , and many other benefits that enrich both your professional and personal life. 

 Professional Experience:  You bring several years of experience as a Senior Product Manager in platform, infrastructure, or technically complex product environments, with a proven ability to operate effectively under delivery pressure while shaping longer-term product direction.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About Typeform

Typeform helps people create better conversations at scale.

Millions of people use Typeform to collect information, understand their customers, generate leads, run research, gather feedback, and power workflows across their businesses.

We are continuing to evolve Typeform from a form builder into a broader platform for collecting, understanding, and acting on information. AI is becoming a major part of that direction, both through experiences we build for customers and through making Typeform easier for AI agents and other products to interact with.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape what comes next.

The role

As a Senior Product Manager at Typeform, you will own a meaningful product area and work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Research, Marketing, and other teams to turn customer problems and business opportunities into products people genuinely want to use.

You will be responsible for understanding the problem space, setting product direction, deciding where the team should focus, and helping the team move from insight to execution.

This is not a role where Product simply writes requirements and hands them to Engineering.

We expect our Product Managers to be close to customers, opinionated about the problems worth solving, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and able to bring teams together around a clear direction.

You will balance customer value, product quality, technical considerations, and commercial impact while helping the team move quickly and learn.

What you will do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for a key area of the Typeform product.
  • Build a strong understanding of our customers, their workflows, and the problems they are trying to solve.
  • Identify opportunities through customer conversations, behavioural data, research, market insight, and product intuition.
  • Turn broad problems into clear product bets, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Design and Engineering from discovery through delivery.
  • Work with Data and Research to understand customer behaviour and evaluate whether what we build is working.
  • Make thoughtful prioritisation decisions across customer needs, business goals, technical investment, and product quality.
  • Define success measures and use them to guide product decisions before and after launch.
  • Run experiments where appropriate and use the results to shape future product direction.
  • Work with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and other teams to ensure we understand the wider customer and commercial context.
  • Communicate product direction clearly and build alignment across teams and leadership.
  • Help teams move from ideas to shipped experiences without losing sight of the original customer problem.
  • Look beyond individual features and think about how your product area contributes to the wider Typeform platform.
  • Explore how AI can improve the customer experience, change existing workflows, and create new ways for customers to get value from Typeform.

What we are looking for

  • You have significant experience building and scaling digital products, ideally within SaaS, product led growth, collaboration software, productivity tools, or another strong product environment.
  • Comfortable taking on messy, ambiguous product problems and bringing structure and direction to them.
  • A strong focus on customer problems and outcomes, rather than jumping straight to features.
  • Strong product judgement, with the ability to use customer insight, data, and context to make good decisions.
  • Close collaboration with Engineering and Design, with product development treated as a shared discipline.
  • Able to set a clear product direction while staying practical about what the team should focus on next.
  • Confident making trade offs, making decisions, and explaining the thinking behind them.
  • Good judgement around when to experiment, when to research, and when there is enough evidence to move forward.
  • Clear communication, with the ability to adapt complex ideas for different audiences.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions can influence activation, engagement, retention, expansion, and revenue.
  • Curiosity about AI and how it is changing the way products are built and how customers interact w

jobs.title: Product Owner / Manager – DEXIOS SaaS-Plattform (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
___________________________________________________________________________ DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!

 Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung 
 Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
 Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
 Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
 Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
 TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik 
 Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
 Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
 Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
 UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten 
 Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
 Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
 Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
 KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt 
 Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
 Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
 Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
 TEAM – Schnittstellen 
 Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
 Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
 Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
 PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset  
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
 Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
 KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
 Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
 Was diese Rolle nicht ist 
 Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
 Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
 Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
 Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich
 

 Das bieten wir Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
 Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
 KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
 Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen
 Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Ur

jobs.title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.   

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 
  • It’s a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.  
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you’ll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (IntelliJ Scala Plugin)
jobs.description:
At JetBrains, we care deeply about developer tools and the code-writing experience. The Scala plugin for IntelliJ IDEA helps developers work with Scala every day. Supporting that experience means understanding real-world development workflows, staying close to user needs, and continuously improving the tools developers rely on.

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to help improve IntelliJ IDEA’s Scala support. This is a hands-on role focused on understanding developer needs and turning them into practical product improvements. You will work closely with engineers, experiment with modern Scala projects and tooling, analyze user feedback, investigate pain points in areas such as build systems, debugging, and code insight, and test ideas through prototypes and direct user interaction.

Our goal is to provide developers with a reliable and productive environment for working with Scala and its ecosystem. We’re looking for someone who enjoys developer tools, understands technical trade-offs, and likes improving products through close collaboration with both users and engineers.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the product vision for the Scala plugin, ensuring it provides fast, correct, and trustworthy IDE support that evolves with the language.
  • Analyze product usage statistics and run a consistent pipeline of user interviews to ground decisions in real workflows.
  • Use IntelliJ IDEA with the Scala plugin daily – dogfooding features, catching regressions, and validating the developer experience first-hand.
  • Maintain and develop reference projects that serve as showcases for new features, material for conference demos, and a living test bed for DX quality.
  • Own and continuously adapt the plugin roadmap for short-term release goals, mid-term initiatives, and longer-term projects related to the Scala ecosystem.
  • Align plugin planning with Scala compiler releases and IntelliJ IDEA release trains.
  • Make judgments about trade-offs and say "no" when cost, risk, or maintenance burden outweighs user value.
  • Define problem statements, success criteria, and scope for features, and then collaborate with engineers to validate and refine them.
  • Represent core Scala stakeholders – developers and library authors – and prioritize recurring pain points, for example, false positives, slow analysis, unreliable refactorings, onboarding pain points, and AI agent integrations.
  • Coordinate with Developer Advocates, the IntelliJ IDEA and Marketing teams, and other JetBrains teams.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has professional software development experience in Scala (this is a must).
  • Has at least five years of experience in technical product management or a comparable role in a complex technical domain.
  • Works closely with the product instead of relying solely on reports and meetings.
  • Has experience with AI coding tools and agents, and curiosity about how they are reshaping developer workflows.
  • Can define clear roadmaps with problem statements, success criteria, and explicit trade-offs.
  • Has strong communication skills in English – written and spoken – for both technical peers and executive audiences.
  • Is ready to represent the product externally at conferences, in blog posts, and in community interactions.
  • Takes the developer experience personally – not as an abstract metric, but as something they feel in their own daily workflow.

We'd be especially thrilled if you:

  • Have experience developing IntelliJ Platform plugins or working with the IntelliJ Platform SDK, or have other technical experience with language tooling and IDEs.
  • Have built or contributed to evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, or quality measurement systems.
  • Have given technical talks or published content aimed at developer audiences.

Why join JetBrains? 

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. 
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.

jobs.title: Product Owner Data & AI (m/f/d) – fluege.de
jobs.description:
Introduction

 TC Flights Germany is known for operating one of the most successful flight search portals in Germany— fluege.de . We are part of Tongcheng Travel, an internationally active company in online travel distribution. Our vision is to be Germany’s top choice for comparing and booking flights.

 We offer our customers a user-friendly and personalized booking experience. We achieve this together with all our employees, who proactively contribute their individual strengths and ideas in a flexible and modern work environment. We place great value on a positive and motivating atmosphere where everyone enjoys coming to work. We take the initiative, take responsibility, respect one another, drive change, are eager to learn, and develop solutions as a team.

 Do you want to help shape the future of data-driven products at fluege.de ? Are you comfortable working at the intersection of business, technology and data, and interested in not only developing AI solutions but also driving their strategic direction?

 As a Product Owner Data & AI (m/f/d) , you combine product ownership with expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science and Generative AI. Together with our business teams, you identify and prioritize high-value use cases and develop innovative solutions with measurable business impact. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of modern data and AI products and act as a key link between business, analytics and technology.

 Does this sound interesting to you? Then join our team and help shape the future of data-driven products at fluege.de . This position is a temporary parental leave cover for approximately 15 months.

 Your tasks

 
 Own the roadmap for our Data, Analytics and AI products and prioritize initiatives based on business value and strategic relevance

 Identify data-driven opportunities together with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into AI and Machine Learning solutions

 Analyze complex datasets, develop predictive models and derive actionable recommendations

 Design, build and evaluate Machine Learning models and modern AI solutions using LLMs, RAG and agent-based workflows

 Manage the full product lifecycle, from problem definition and development to validation and production deployment

 Ensure the operation, monitoring and continuous improvement of AI systems in modern cloud environments

 Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and other stakeholders while communicating progress, risks and results transparently

 
 Your profile

 
 Several years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, AI Engineering or Advanced Analytics

 Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a similar role with responsibility for products, projects or complex initiatives

 Strong knowledge of Python, SQL and modern Data Science and Machine Learning frameworks

 Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

 Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and operating AI and ML solutions in production environments

 Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD, monitoring and the continuous improvement of production systems

 Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to connect technical and business requirements

 Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills

 
 What we offer

 
 Onboarding : professional orientation, buddy program, welcome week

 Agile work environment : active participation in shaping our products and strategy

 Work-life balance : 30 days of paid vacation, remote work in Germany and worldwide with Workflex, sabbatical, work-from-home option

 Professional Development : Individual development plans, coaching, online/offline training and workshops, continuous feedback

 Corporate Social Responsibility : Certified climate partner since 2023

 Food & Beverages : Meal allowance, free drinks and food

 Recognition : Up to 34 vacation days depending on length of service, anniversary bonus, employee referral bonus

 Events : Regular team, company, and office events

 Well-being : Monthly subsidy for EGYM Wellpass membership, workplace health management, company physician, sports activities and events, discounts at gyms, company pension plan

 Diversity : Conscious focus on international teams and collaboration

 Mobility : Subsidy for the Deutschland-Ticket, JobRad

 
 Your trip to us

 Everyone is welcome here - no matter who you are or where you’re from. We look forward to receiving every application. At fluege.de , there’s room for diversity!

 We’ve made the pre-check-in process as simple as possible. Just send us your resume, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. We look forward to receiving your application.

 Ready for Boarding? 

 If you have any questions, feel free to email us at .

jobs.title: Group Product Manager [Klaxoon]
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Klaxoon — the product area responsible for Wrike’s visual collaboration strategy and the evolution of whiteboarding experiences within the broader CWM platform.

In this role, you will define and lead the strategy of Wrike Whiteboards across the key pillars: whiteboard core experience, AI strategy, vertical-oriented use cases, convergence between Wrike and Klaxoon, and customer retention. You will balance innovation, customer stewardship, product unification, and business needs while shaping the future role of visual collaboration in Wrike.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product strategy, people leadership, customer empathy, AI-native thinking, and organizational integration. You will help transform Klaxoon into a world-class visual collaboration tool while developing the PM team into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

  • Define and drive the Klaxoon strategy: Set the vision, priorities, and roadmap for Klaxoon across the core whiteboard experience, AI strategy, vertical differentiation, and Wrike/Klaxoon convergence into a single seamless product.
  • Grow whiteboard adoption and experience: Continuously raise the bar on the Klaxoon product experience to make it a world-class visual collaboration tool, with strong focus on driving adoption among Wrike customers and identifying high-value vertical use cases.
  • Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to work AI-natively, identifying where agentic workflows can change how the team operates and scales output.
  • Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers - helping them move from feature ownership to strategic product leadership while building a shared product culture across Wrike and Klaxoon.

Your qualifications:

  • Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, positioning, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs.
  • Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer expectations, product convergence, innovation, and long-term strategic direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and executive leadership.
  • People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
  • AI-native thinking: Practical understanding of AI-native product strategy and ability to identify differentiated AI use cases in visual collaboration.
  • Good UX judgment: Ability to balance product power, simplicity, adoption, and customer experience in collaborative tools.

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in visual collaboration, whiteboarding, CWM, work management, or team collaboration products.
  • Practical understanding of agentic workflows and AI-native product development.
  • Proficiency in French is a strong plus - the team is mostly France-based.
  • Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex product areas for the AI-native future.

About the Role:

  • Visual collaboration impact: You will shape the future of Klaxoon as a world-class whiteboarding and visual collaboration experience inside Wrike.
  • Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing adoption, AI, vertical strategy, customer retention, product convergence, and innovation in one highly visible product area.
  • AI-native transformation: You will help define how visual collaboration evolves in a future where AI changes
